# Bromberg Translations

> > Bromberglearn is an elearning platform offering professional development courses in accent modification, cultural competence, and cross-cultural communication.

Bromberg Translations operates Bromberglearn, an elearning platform founded by Zouheir Moussa and Nisrine Hashem. The platform specializes in courses designed to help professionals improve communication skills, cultural awareness, and workplace effectiveness across diverse environments.

## Key Topics

- Bromberglearn
- Accent Modification for Professionals
- Cultural Competence
- Cross-Cultural Communication
- Customer Service Training
- Cultural Sensitivity
- Professional Development
- elearning Platform
- Cybersecurity Basics
- Working Across Cultures
- Zouheir Moussa
- Nisrine Hashem

## Platform Overview

- [Bromberglearn Home](https://elearning.brombergtranslations.com/): Bromberglearn elearning platform homepage with courses on accent modification and professional development.
